messages:
Emma (CEO): Quick checkpoint — three priorities this week: Private GA timing, cost/perf delta to present to the board, and the updated retention policy. Short notes below, please ack and call out blockers.

Ravi (VP Engineering): Ack. Autoscaler tuning + kernel-selection fixes are top infra items. Will prioritize canary tests.

Emma (CEO): Decision: shifting Private GA to the week of May 18 to give us an extra stabilization sprint. Not cancelling — just avoiding overlap with large enterprise onboarding.

Sofia (VP Product): Understood. I'll finish GA copy and pricing language by Friday and add a 'what's new' doc for existing Dedicated customers.

Marta (Head of Customer Success): I'll draft the customer comms plan + FAQ. Plan to soft-notify existing beta customers the day before GA.

Jamal (Head of Infra): Incident recap from last night: ingress spike traced to a bad nginx pool change; rollback at 03:12 UTC. No data loss; error budget hit ~0.4%. Follow-up: add stricter network-config canary.

Emma (CEO): Good catch — add a canary gate to the release checklist. Short-circuit rollout if 5xx > 0.5% in first 10m.

Ravi (VP Engineering): Will add that gate. Autoscaler patch includes backlog sizing improvements and a ramp test in canary. Plan: canary tonight, targeted full rollout Thu AM.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started by Ravi — build r-infer/sha@ab12cd — canary=10% -> monitors attached.

Sofia (VP Product): Quick metrics: p95 inference latency is down ~8% after KV-cache tweaks; cost per 1k tokens improved ~12% vs last month. Adding these to the GA deck.

Emma (CEO): Great. Two asks for the board packet: 1) clear cost delta vs major cloud alternatives, 2) concise compliance status for Private (KMS/HSM). Who owns?

Sofia (VP Product): I'll draft the cost slide. Jamal can supply the KMS/HSM blurb.

Jamal (Head of Infra): KMS integration is complete for EU regions; HSM POC with partner is in progress. ETA for POC: ~2 weeks.

Marta (Head of Customer Success): I'll align the customer messaging with the compliance blurb once Jamal shares the copy.

Emma (CEO): Action items:
- @Ravi: autoscaler canary + rollout (ETA Thu AM)
- @Sofia: cost slide + GA copy (ETA Fri)
- @Jamal: HSM POC update + add canary gate (ETA 2w / canary gate today)
- @Marta: comms plan + FAQ (ETA day-before-GA)

Emma (CEO): Policy change: audit logs retention extended to 1 year; non-prod operational logs retention reduced to 90 days. Raise concerns now. Snippet: 

```
data_retention_days: 90
audit_log_ttl_days: 365
```

Ravi (VP Engineering): No objections. We'll add a migration script for archived logs.

Marta (Head of Customer Success): I'll mention retention changes in comms and include export/backup instructions for customers who need longer access.

Emma (CEO): Thanks team — I'll fold these bullets into the board update tonight. If anything blocks your ETA, ping me directly. :rocket:
